steps.title: Open Cockpit
steps.narration: This iteration is backend-only with no visible product changes. We confirm the watch lifecycle transitions still work correctly after internal manager changes.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit homepage with the watch controls (Simulated source already selected by default).

steps.title: Watch a simulated ticker
steps.narration: Enter a ticker symbol and start watching to confirm the watch creation still works after manager changes.
steps.point_out: Status dot changes to 'live' and the Tape State panel shows tape events.

steps.title: Click Watch
steps.narration: Begin watching the ticker to verify the watch lifecycle begins correctly.
steps.point_out: Status transitions to 'live' and the Tape State panel starts showing bid absorption events.

steps.title: Pause the watch
steps.narration: Pause the live stream to confirm pause transitions work correctly.
steps.point_out: Status dot changes to 'paused' and the Pause button relabels to Resume.

steps.title: Resume watching
steps.narration: Resume the stream to verify the resume transition works.
steps.point_out: Status returns to 'live' and the button relabels back to Pause.

steps.title: Stop the watch
steps.narration: Stop the watch to confirm the lifecycle transitions to closed state.
steps.point_out: Status returns to 'idle' and the Cockpit resets to 'No ticker watched' placeholder.

steps.title: Verify Structure page unchanged
steps.narration: Check that the Structure page still renders normally — no visible product change from this backend-only iteration.
steps.point_out: The Structure page loads with its heading and controls intact.

steps.title: Verify Desk page unchanged
steps.narration: Confirm the Desk page also renders normally.
steps.point_out: The Desk page loads with its heading and controls.
